thesis: The speakers discuss GTCR's 'leader strategy,' which prioritizes investing in proven money-making CEOs who have created equity value in specific industries like insurance brokerage, rather than chasing deals indiscriminately. They argue that great leaders often do not transcend across different industries or size milestones, so the firm backs CEOs to run companies within the specific sectors where they have previously built value to avoid mistakes and reduce learning curves.
